rationale: Three minutes into the trade, OCTV continues to consolidate tightly near the top of its daily range (95.6%) on light pullback volume, holding firmly above the rising 5-minute 9-EMA ($21.40) and our $21.37 invalidation level. The most recent 1-minute dip to $21.42 was immediately absorbed to close back at $21.44, while broad market tailwinds have strengthened further (SPY +4.86%, VIXY -14.97%). With the structural thesis fully intact and tight risk defined just below the moving average, the evidence supports holding for a potential break above the $21.50 intraday high.
